verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe's batch mode documents creating a job via POST /aiservices/scribe/jobs and polling a get-status endpoint. Jobs move through documented states (QUEUED, PROCESSING, SUCCEEDED, PARTIAL, FAILED, CANCELED), and status responses include per-state file counts and result locations, with per-file states and a get-file retrieval endpoint. The OpenAPI probe corroborates that the batch-job and status paths exist. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of polling behavior, and documented polling guidance (intervals, rate limits).

support.subject: As a developer, I create a transcription job and poll its status through documented job states until the result is ready

citations.quote: Jobs expose QUEUED, PROCESSING, SUCCEEDED, PARTIAL, FAILED, and CANCELED states, while status responses include per-state file counts and result locations.
Batch mode documents POST /aiservices/scribe/jobs plus get-status, list-jobs, cancel-job, list-files, and get-file endpoints.
Per-file states include FILE_FAILED and FILE_SKIPPED
